text.p: Tropical Storm Beth has top winds near 50 mph but is strengthening in the Philippine Sea. It is expected to become a typhoon with top winds of 75 mph before landfall in the far northern portion of the Philippines over northeastern Luzon, in 36-40 hours. A storm surge, wind damage, flooding, and mudslides. Shipping in the region will also be at risk.

Tropical Depression 12 is currently centered about 410 miles south southwest of Havana, Cuba, with top winds near 35 mph. It is moving northwest about 10 mph and is expected to turn to the north today with some intensification. A hurricane watch is up for western Cuba including the Isle of Youth and the Mainland Provinces of Pinar Del Rio and Havana. A tropical storm warning is up for the Yucatan East Coast from Isla Muteres to Bahia De Chetumal. There will be an increased risk to shipping. Heavy rains the next couple days in western Cuba may lead to flooding.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
